blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — Barangay Cogon in this city plans to harness solar energy to cut electricity expenses and redirect savings to livelihood programs and other community services, as it strives to become a green energy pioneer in Bohol. Barangay officials are looking at a solar power project estimated to cost P2.3 million as part of efforts to promote renewable energy and raise environmental awareness among residents. Engr. Geneson Balbin, barangay captain of Cogon, said the barangay spends about P120,000 monthly on electricity. READ: PH has plenty of sun – so why isn’t solar booming yet?
